capability.description: Open a new sub-account for a member and read its account number; a human performs the final confirmation

goal: Look up member {{memberId}} and open a new {{accountType}} sub-account for them with nickname {{nickname}} and an initial deposit of {{initialDeposit}}, confirm it, and read the new account number

nickname.description: Nickname of the new sub-account; the application rejects special characters

initialDeposit.description: Initial deposit in dollars, e.g. 123.45; the application requires at least 25.00

accountNumber.description: Number of the new sub-account as displayed, e.g. 12345ABCD000000
